findings.title: Known pre-dispatch pause exception would be classified as ambiguous effect

findings.title: Household artifact identity and adoption cannot be inferred from private intent result or checkpoint status
findings.evidence: Timeline scope is tenant+installation only; checkpoint status has active/waiting_for_proof/completed/failed/needs_help. OwnerInitiatives selects PERSONAL_INTENT_ADOPTED for one private owner and artifact returns completed .md content.
findings.requiredBoundary: Keep facility state/adoption/version in source-bound scoped event data/projected history using current household/owner grants. Do not add generic status variants/schema or turn private .md/task completion into household adoption. Preserve stable provision identity across version changes.

findings.title: Durable management transition must not silently overwrite file state, revive STOP or disable unrelated legacy rights
findings.evidence: Provider currently reads current.json/source/reference; timeline transition locks one DB checkpoint with expected_revision and does not atomically update that file. Minimal contract requires pause acknowledgement, exact source/version, idempotency, STOP above resume, restore no duplicate and legacy authorization unchanged.
findings.requiredBoundary: Make source of truth/revision and fail-closed partial-transfer ordering explicit in patch. Repeated request returns its bound original receipt; altered payload/stale version cannot replay as new adoption. Restore absent/conflicting managed state is non-dispatchable, without reinterpreting valid unmanaged legacy bindings as adoption or new denial by accident.

findings.requiredBoundary: Register proposed/unverified and separate owner adoption. Missing actual positive realization/effect proof must keep resume nonactive with explicit pending reason; no synthetic active result or full-card closure.
